facts.fact: Q2FY27 (Sep-2026 quarter, Screener consolidated): revenue Rs450 cr (-13% YoY), EBITDA Rs98 cr (22% margin), other income Rs8 cr, PAT Rs52 cr, EPS Rs40.24. H1FY27 revenue Rs1,092 cr (+35%).

Sep-2026 shareholding: promoters 32.26% (from 32.62%), FIIs 21.93%, DIIs 16.25%, 49,741 shareholders.
Goldman Sachs reported to have kept Buy with a Rs25,275 target after Q2FY27 ('Q2 beat estimates despite a 13% sales decline').
S&P Global consensus (4 analysts): Strong Buy, mean target Rs24,675 (range Rs22,900-27,225); FY27E EPS Rs328.1, revenue Rs2,321 cr.
Management to attend the JM Financial India conference (17-Nov-2026).
Share price ~Rs20,550-21,450 in mid/late Nov-2026; Screener shows a 52-week high/low of Rs24,235/11,500.
